items.exampleEn: Firstly, let me explain why we are here today.
items.exampleZh: 首先，讓我說明我們今天為什麼在這裡。

items.exampleEn: English has become the de facto language of international business.
items.exampleZh: 英語已成為國際商務中實際上的通用語言。

items.exampleEn: Ow! I hit my knee on the desk.
items.exampleZh: 哎喲！我的膝蓋撞到桌子了。

items.exampleEn: The flight was delayed owing to bad weather.
items.exampleZh: 班機因為天氣不好而延誤。

items.exampleEn: My pa taught me how to fix a bike.
items.exampleZh: 我爸教我怎麼修腳踏車。

items.exampleEn: The so-called cheap flight cost us more in the end.
items.exampleZh: 那班所謂的便宜航班，最後反而讓我們花更多錢。

items.exampleEn: My son told me proudly that three times four is twelve.
items.exampleZh: 我兒子很得意地告訴我，三乘以四等於十二。

items.sentenceEn: Four times five is twenty, so we need twenty chairs.
items.sentenceZh: 四乘以五是二十，所以我們需要二十張椅子。

items.audioEn: Ow! This box is much heavier than I thought. Can you help me?
items.audioZh: 哎喲！這個箱子比我想的重多了。你可以幫我嗎？

items.sentenceEn: Firstly, check that all the windows are closed.
items.sentenceZh: 首先，檢查所有的窗戶都關好了。

items.sentenceEn: Everyone was tired after the so-called quick meeting.
items.sentenceZh: 開完那場所謂的簡短會議後，大家都累了。

items.stemEn: In practice, Lisa is the ____ manager, although her title is assistant.
items.stemZh: 實際上 Lisa 才是真正管事的經理，雖然她的職稱是助理。

items.stemEn: ____ the high cost of rent, many small shops have moved out of the city center.
items.stemZh: 由於房租太高，許多小店已經搬離市中心。

items.passageEn: When I was ten, I spent a summer on our family farm with my pa. He was the de facto boss there, although my uncle owned the farm. He gave me two rules: firstly, feed the chickens before breakfast; secondly, always close the gate. Then he gave me a so-called easy job: carrying water from the river. Owing to the hot weather, the buckets felt very heavy. "Ow, my back!" I cried after the first trip. Pa laughed and said, "Ten trips times two buckets is twenty buckets. Only eighteen more to go!" By the end of the summer, I was much stronger, and the job really did feel easy.
items.passageZh: 我十歲那年，和我爸在家裡的農場過了一個暑假。雖然農場是我叔叔的，但實際上是我爸在作主。他給了我兩條規矩：第一，早餐前先餵雞；第二，一定要把柵門關好。接著他給了我一個所謂很輕鬆的工作：從河邊提水。因為天氣很熱，水桶感覺非常重。第一趟回來我就大叫：「哎喲，我的背！」我爸笑著說：「十趟乘以兩桶就是二十桶，只剩十八桶了！」到了暑假結束時，我變得強壯許多，那份工作也真的變輕鬆了。

questions.questionZh: 作者為什麼覺得水桶很重？

items.promptZh: 由於人手不足，這家店提早關門了。
referenceEn: Owing to a lack of staff, the shop closed early.
The store closed early owing to a shortage of workers.
rubricZh: owing to 後面接名詞（例如 owing to a lack of staff），可放句首或句尾
「人手不足」可寫 a lack of staff、a shortage of workers 等；「提早關門」用過去式（例如 closed early）

items.promptZh: 這間所謂的五星級飯店，房間裡竟然沒有熱水。
referenceEn: This so-called five-star hotel had no hot water in the rooms.
There was no hot water in the rooms of this so-called five-star hotel.
rubricZh: so-called 放在名詞前，表示「號稱的、名不副實的」（例如 this so-called five-star hotel 等）
「沒有熱水」可寫，例如 had no hot water、there was no hot water 等
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 had、has 等）
